body:
I had used nitrous hundred of times before and it has been great, in my experience the store bought box of canisters are the best, most effective, and most pleasant.
I didn't have a cracker ( the thing used to extract gas from canisters) so I bought a can of whip cream, no name brand, seeing as they are propelled by nitrous. I hit it like there was no tomorrow, hit after hit until empty.
It was great for the first 10 seconds but then things took a drastic turn, there was panic, hyperventilation, nausea, and a head ache like you wouldnt believe, this has never happened before. For the rest of the night I was feeling uneasy and nauseous, whether this is because I ingested the whip cream after the nitrous is debateable, but all I am saying is I bought no name whipcream and inhaled the nitrous followed by eating the whipcream.
